data.name: Maatuq
data.gender_notes: Maatuq is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, the name Maatuq is derived from the root 'A-T-Q'. It means 'The Invited One'. This name signifies a person who is honored and welcomed, especially by Allah. The name Maatuq carries the meaning “The Invited One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maatuq usually hope their child will grow to embody the invited one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes Allah's invitation and love towards His creation.
data.etymology: Maatuq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Invited One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maatuq total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: معتوق
in_arabic.meaning: معتوق يعني المعتق من العبودية أو المنجى من الشدائد
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم معتوق مشتق من الفعل عتق، وهو يعني التحرير من العبودية أو النجاة من الشدائد. في اللغة العربية، العتق يعني التحرير أو الإعتاق. ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مواضع تتعلق بالعتق، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَمَا كَانَ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهِمُ مِن سُلْطَانٍ إِلَّا لِنَعْلَمَ مَن يَخَافُ اللَّهَ مِن ظُهُورِهِمْ وَمَن يَخَافُ اللَّهَ مِن بَطْنِهِم وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَلِيمٌ بِمَن يَتَّقِيهِ وَمَن يَعْتَقُ مِنَ النَّارِ' (التحريم: 10). يعتبر اسم معتوق ذا أهمية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يرمز إلى الحرية والنجاة.

in_urdu.name: معتوق
in_urdu.meaning: معتوق کا مطلب ہوتا ہے آزاد شدہ یا مشکلات سے نجات یافتہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: معتوق نام عربی زبان کے الفاظ 'عتق' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے آزادی یا مشکلات سے نجات۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت اہم ہے کیونکہ یہ آزادی اور نجات کی علامت ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان، یہ نام روایتی اور مذہبی اہمیت کا حامل ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मअतूक
in_hindi.meaning: मअतूक का अर्थ है आजाद किया हुआ या कठिनाइयों से मुक्त
in_hindi.long_meaning: मअतूक नाम अरबी भाषा के शब्दों से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है आजादी या कठिनाइयों से मुक्ति। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में पारंपरिक और धार्मिक महत्व रखता है। यह नाम स्वतंत्रता और मुक्ति का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: معتوق
in_pashto.meaning: معتوق د آزاد شوي یا له ستونزو څخه د خلاصون معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: معتوق نوم د عربی ژبې د 'عتق' کلمې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د آزادۍ یا له ستونزو څخه د خلاصون معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو او مذهبي ارزښتونو په منځ کې ډیر مهم دی.

in_english.name: Maatuq
in_english.meaning: Maatuq means liberated or rescued from difficulties
in_english.long_meaning: The name Maatuq is derived from the Arabic root 'عتق' (a-ta-qa), which means to liberate or to free. In Islamic tradition, the term 'a'taqa' is used to signify emancipation from slavery or hardship. The Quran references the concept of liberation in several verses, emphasizing its spiritual significance. Maatuq symbolizes freedom, deliverance, and divine mercy, reflecting positive personality traits such as compassion and resilience. It is used across various Muslim cultures, signifying a strong connection to Islamic heritage.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Abd al-Hakam, The History of the Conquests of Spain, Book II: The Reign of Muhammad ibn Abd al-Aziz (r. 788-801)
historical_references.context: Maatuq ibn Yazid, a Berber ruler of the Ripuarian March, who occupied Tangier and other cities in Morocco, was defeated by Muhammad ibn Abd al-Aziz. Maatuq's defeat marked the end of Berber resistance to Umayyad rule in the Maghreb.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun, The Muqaddimah, Volume 1, Book 1, Chapter 11: The Berbers Before the Arrival of the Arabs
historical_references.context: Maatuq was the founder of the Kahina dynasty in ancient Numidia (present-day Algeria and Tunisia). He was a Berber king who ruled in the late pre-Islamic era and is known for his military campaigns and expansion of his kingdom.
